_notes: Tagged copy of script.txt for ElevenLabs v4. Edit 'performed' freely: tags in [brackets] direct delivery and are not spoken.
'text' must match the script line; if you edit the script, the line falls back to untagged until you update it here.

Character sketch (for choosing voices): BILLY BATSON - teenage boy radio announcer, eager, earnest, easily flustered. CAPTAIN MARVEL - adult hero, big warm baritone, confident and good-humoured. PROFESSOR SMITH - elderly eccentric scientist, reedy, swings between lecturing and hysteria. MR. MORRIS - Billy's boss, hearty middle-aged bluster. MISS DALSHAW - brisk receptionist. THE GIRL - imperious invasion leader. SOLDIERS - gruff heavies. ELEVATOR OPERATOR - bored announcer.
